concepts.name: 01-reciprocidade
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one distinctive professional icon concept for Unveil, a privacy-first frontend app that analyzes an Instagram data export locally to reveal mutual connections, who follows back and one-way relationships. Concept: Reciprocidade: two bold interlocking open links, subtly shaping a U, one complete reciprocal connection and one deliberate open endpoint. Custom asymmetric geometric silhouette, no arrows. Style: confident flat vector-like graphic, bespoke optical geometry, strong negative space, recognizable at favicon size. Palette: solid moss green #a0ba46 with at most a small lighter #b3cc5c accent, on perfectly neutral near-black #141414 background. Square canvas, centered single large symbol with generous clear margin. No lettering, no wordmark, no labels, no presentation board, no mockup, no gradient, no glow, no 3D, no texture, no Instagram logo, no generic AI sparkle. Output one icon only.
